jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Poker
jobs.description:
Caesars Digital is building its next poker product from the ground up, and this role will own it.

As the Senior Product Manager - Poker, you will lead the end-to-end product strategy and execution for a new standalone poker application and the poker experience embedded across Caesars Digital product, including our Sportsbook and iCasino products. You will work at the intersection of a third-party poker platform, iGaming platform, and our Player Account Management (PAM) system and be the connective tissue to turn those systems into a seamless player experience.

If you’ve worked on a poker product before and you understand what makes the player experience great, this role is for you.

The salary range for this position is $165,000 - $180,000 USD, which is dependent on a several factors including relevant experience, geography, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k)-matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses. This role includes paid Flexible Time Off and paid company holidays.
WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Required
- 5+ years of product manage experience with digital consumer products, ideally in iGaming, online gaming, or a closely
related regulated vertical
- Direct experience with online poker, either as a PM who has owned a poker product, operator, analyst, or deep gameplay
experience
- Experience managing vendor integrations as a PM, understanding how to work with them and get the best out of them
- Comfort operating in a greenfield environment; you’ve launched a new product or led a 0-1 initiative before and can build
structure when none exists.
- Solid understanding of regulated gaming environments; player verification, responsible gaming requirements, state level
regulations

Preferred
- Background in a multi-state online gambling product launch
- Familiarity with poker specific platform technology
- Experience working within a shared wallet, unified account system across regulated verticals
- You play poker!
WHAT YOU’LL DO

Poker App & Platform Ownership
- Own the product roadmap and delivery for a new dedicated poker application (iOS, Android, and web) from initial launch
through post-launch iterations
- Define the end-to end player journey from registration, lobby and game selection, cashier, and responsible gaming
- Drive the integration between the Caesars iGaming platform and the poker platform vendor, serving as the primary product
voice
- Translate vendor platform capabilities into a differentiated Caesars product experience, making the product ours
- Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing player experience improvements, vendor integration work, regulatory
requirements, and internal stakeholder requests.

Cross-Product Poker Experience
- Own the poker tab and entry points within Caesars Sportsbook & iCasino products, ensuring a coherent cross-sell
experience that drives acquisition and engagement across verticals
- Define & maintain consistent UX standards across the standalone poker app and embedded poker surfaces
- Partner with Sportsbook, iCasino, & PAM product teams to coordinate shared dependencies (account, wallet, promotions)

Vendor & Stakeholder Management
- Serve as the primary product liaison with the poker platform vendor, managing the product relationship, roadmap
alignment, feature requests, and SLA accountability.
- Partner with internal Caesars poker business stakeholders to understand the game, player demographics, competitive
landscape, and go to market strategy that shapes the product
- Represent product priorities across cross functional teams such as Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Marketing

jobs.title: Director of Product, Rewards & Engagement
jobs.description:
This role is responsible for building and maintaining our rewards and engagement features for our real-money gaming products (Caesars Palace Online Casino, Horseshoe Online Casino, and Caesars Sportsbook). As Director of Product - Digital Rewards & Engagement, you will work with key stakeholders on Casino, Sportsbook, and Marketing to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of the online Rewards experience for our digital suite of real-money gaming products - leveraging the Caesars Rewards program to create differentiated loyalty and engagement features for our digital players.

The salary range for this position is $175,000 - $190,000 USD, which is dependent on a several factors including relevant experience, geography, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k)-matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses. This role includes paid Flexible Time Off and paid company holidays.
- 5+ Years Product Management Experience

- Experience in regulated iGaming/Sports betting markets preferred

- Experience with omni-channel loyalty programs preferred

- Experience working with executive stakeholders preferred
- Define and own the long-term vision and product roadmap for loyalty, rewards, and engagement across digital products.
- Develop innovative loyalty mechanics that utilize the existing Caesars Rewards program structure to maximize player engagement and lifetime value.
- Work with senior stakeholders to align the digital Caesars Rewards strategy with business and commercial goals, player segmentation strategies, and responsible gaming principles.
- Partner closely with engineering, promotions, CRM, marketing, compliance, and operations teams.
- Serve as the product authority on Caesars Rewards in the digital products.
- Own the full product lifecycle for Caesars Rewards in our real-money gaming suite of products - from concept and regulatory review through launch and continuous optimization.
- Optimize UX for earning, tracking, and redeeming rewards across casino and sportsbook journeys.
- Define and track KPIs including activation, engagement, retention, churn, MARPU, Player LTV, bonus cost efficiency, and Caesars Rewards redemption rates.
- Work with Casino, Sportsbook, and Marketing stakeholders to balance digital reinvestment through the Caesars Rewards program with profitability.
- Present performance insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
- Lead integration efforts of third-party loyalty vendors, CRM platforms, payments, and any additional relevant providers.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders on product strategy and vision for third-party promotions and exclusive offers (ex. Shop takeovers, branded promotions, etc.)
- Ensure extensibility for new jurisdictions, brands, and regulatory requirements.
